candidates.source_name: World Bank Global Findex Database — download data (country-level XLSX/CSV/DTA)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical demand-side financial inclusion micro/aggregate data including Kosovo: account ownership, debit/credit card ownership, digital payments made/received, cash-only behaviour. Machine-readable country-level files for 2011, 2014, 2017, 2021, 2024 waves — the only cross-country comparable demand-side cash-usage measure for Kosovo.
candidates.source_subtype: IFI statistical dataset / survey data download
candidates.legal_status: public, CC-BY style World Bank open data terms (attribution required)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled annual/wave-triggered download of the country-level XLSX/CSV, parse Kosovo (XKX) rows into indicator time series; re-check after each Findex wave release.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from Findex landing page
queries_used: World Bank Global Findex Kosovo account ownership data

candidates.source_name: Global Findex Database 2025 microdata (World Bank Microdata Library, catalog 7860)

candidates.access_status: registration/licence request may be required for microdata download
candidates.legal_status: public licensed microdata; terms per catalogue entry

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr, Cyrillic) searching for IFI Kosovo financial-inclusion/payments data returned no IFI Kosovo material.
negative_findings.result_summary: The query 'Светска банка Косово финансијска укљученост подаци платни промет извештај' returned only Serbia/North Macedonia banking documents (NBS payment statistics, KPMG AML risk assessment, WB Serbia projects) — no World Bank/IMF/EBRD Kosovo dataset or report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: IFIs do not appear to publish Kosovo financial-access material in Serbian, and Serbian-language searching is additionally distorted by the political naming of Kosovo. Serbian-language monitoring should therefore be aimed at local/Serbian institutional sources, not at the IFI cell.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language IFI-hosted dataset or statistical publication for Kosovo was found on worldbank.org / imf.org / ebrd.com / eib.org / ifc.org.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian-language searching surfaced Kosovo domestic institutions (BQK, universities, media) that cite IFI data, but no IFI-domain Albanian statistical release.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that for this cell, English is the working language of the primary sources, and that local-language coverage must be achieved indirectly via domestic documents that quote IFI figures.

negative_findings.description: EBRD Banking Environment and Performance Survey (BEPS) microdata is not obtainable.
negative_findings.result_summary: EBRD explicitly states BEPS underlying data are not publicly available due to confidentiality agreements with participating banks; only derived research and reports are accessible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents bank-level supply-side analysis for Kosovo from EBRD; collection must be limited to published research outputs.

negative_findings.description: Kosovo POS-terminals-per-100,000-adults could not be confirmed in the search pass as a published IFI series.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results confirmed the IMF FAS ATM-per-100k series for Kosovo (FRED KOSFCAANUM) and global POS commentary, but no Kosovo-specific POS series was surfaced; an sq-language BQK-linked document quoted POS-per-100k figures for 2015/2018, implying such data exists but may be sourced domestically or from a WB study rather than a live IFI series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POS density is a core cell indicator; the collection pipeline must verify whether FAS publishes Kosovo POS variables before relying on it, and be prepared to fall back on CBK data.

coverage_gaps.description: None of the listed URLs were fetched or liveness-tested in this pass; IMF's data portal in particular was recently re-platformed (data.imf.org) and older dataset endpoints may have moved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/verification pass over all candidate URLs; where an IMF endpoint 404s, treat as moved and re-locate via data.imf.org search rather than marking dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Additional IFI/DFI actors publishing Kosovo financial-sector data were not explored in this pass: BIS (CPMI Red Book-type statistics), CEB, KfW/DEG, the Vienna Initiative, EFSE/Finance in Motion, and the World Bank Western Balkans Regular Economic Report series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend a follow-up scouting pass to these actors, especially the Vienna Initiative (which originated the EIB CESEE BLS) and the WB Western Balkans Regular Economic Report for recurring Kosovo financial-sector chapters.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of this cell is effectively empty and no useful sr-language IFI terminology could be established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deprioritise sr-language querying for the IFI cell; reallocate sr coverage to domestic Serbian-language Kosovo sources in other cells.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo-specific World Bank retail-payment-cost study dates from February 2022; no more recent IFI demand-side cash-cost measurement for Kosovo was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Monitor documents.worldbank.org and the IFC/SECO CBK programme for a repeat cost-of-retail-payments study; in the interim treat 2022 cash-cost figures as ageing.

coverage_gaps.description: Two of the highest-value datasets (Findex microdata, WB/EBRD Enterprise Survey microdata) sit behind registration or licence-request flows rather than open download.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish a standing World Bank Microdata Library account and record licence terms so recurring collection is not blocked at run time.

brief: For Kosovo, the IFI layer is the only source of harmonised, cross-country-comparable and machine-readable payments/inclusion data: IMF FAS supplies the supply-side access series (ATMs, branches, accounts, and Kosovo participated heavily in the fintech pilot variables), while World Bank Global Findex supplies the only demand-side account/card/digital-payment and cash-usage measurement, with Enterprise Surveys and the EBRD-EIB-WBG BEEPS adding the firm side and the EIB CESEE Bank Lending Survey adding a semi-annual forward-looking read that explicitly covers Kosovo. The single richest Kosovo-specific artefact found is the World Bank's February 2022 'Retail Payment Costs and Savings in Kosovo' study, which measured cash cost and usage from household, merchant, bank and MTO surveys — but it is ageing and has no confirmed successor. Access is mostly open and automatable (WB Indicators API, Data360, FRED/DBnomics mirrors of FAS), with two exceptions: microdata requires registration, and EBRD's BEPS bank-level data is permanently confidential. Local-language coverage of this cell is structurally absent — IFIs publish only in English for Kosovo, Albanian material appears only where domestic bodies such as BQK re-quote IFI figures, and Serbian-language searching yields nothing at all for this cell.
